tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Full-text search across aidata.stream: documentation, blog posts, changelog, pricing, FAQ and the home page. Returns the best-matching sections with a snippet and a URL (with anchor where available). Use get_page to read a whole page afterwards.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. "connect GA4 service account" or "pricing extra seats".

lang.description: Site language to search: English, French or German.

section.description: Restrict to one section of the site.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Fetch the full text of one aidata.stream page as Markdown. Accepts a path ("/pricing/", "/docs/getting-started/") or an absolute aidata.stream URL. Use list_pages or search_site to find URLs.

url.description: Page path or absolute URL on aidata.stream.

max_chars.description: Truncate the Markdown after this many characters. Use a small value when tool output is size-capped.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List the pages on aidata.stream with title and description, optionally filtered by section and language. Good first call to see what documentation exists.

section.description: Restrict to one section of the site.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Current AI Data Stream plans as structured data: monthly and annual prices in USD, GBP and EUR, what each tier includes, trial terms, extra seat cost and sign-up links. AI usage is never billed by AI Data Stream: users bring their own AI API keys (BYOK).
